# Flightcore Studios

> Professional recording studio in Warsaw, Poland. Founded in 2017 by Aleksander "Dister" Durowicz, Gerard Czarnecki, and Szymon "Sami" Gwóźdź. Flightcore Studios offers recording, mixing, mastering, and music production services. The facility operates 24/7 with three distinct recording spaces featuring high-end equipment including vintage Neumann microphones and FPGA-based real-time Auto-Tune processing.

Website: https://flightcore.pl
Official Documentation: https://docs.flightcore.pl
Languages: Polish (pl), English (en)
Contact: kontakt@flightcore.pl | +48 791 730 204

## Founders and Team

Studio was founded in 2017 by three co-founders:
- **Dister (Aleksander Durowicz)** - Co-founder, vocalist, sound designer, producer with 1000+ tracks. Hip-hop/rap specialist.
- **Gerard (Gerard Czarnecki)** - Co-founder, Studio Manager, audio engineer. Built one of Poland's most recognized studios.
- **Sami (Szymon Gwóźdź)** - Co-founder, audio engineer, acoustician at the National Philharmonic, Mix With the Masters graduate.

Additional team members:
- **Sosad (Szymon Sosada)** - Classically trained oboist, vocal technique and post-production specialist.
- **Maks Jarczewski** - Producer specializing in trap, hyperpop, futuristic sounds.
- **Idea (Jędrzej Kocój)** - Audio engineer and producer, melody and repeat value specialist.

## Awards and Achievements

- 9 Platinum records (ZPAV certified)
- 4 Gold records (ZPAV certified)
- Over 5000 completed recording sessions
- Collaborations with major labels: Warner Music Poland, Sony Music Poland, Def Jam Recordings
- International artists: Lil Gnar, Lil Skies (USA)
- Polish artists: Tymek, Young Leosia, Kizo, Julia Wieniawa, Żabson

## Pricing (net prices in PLN)

Recording sessions:
- Recording with engineer: 200 PLN/hour
- Self-recording: 150 PLN/hour
- Happy Hours (08:00-12:00): 30% discount on all services
- Night package (22:00-06:00): 1000 PLN for 8 hours
- 10-hour package: 1800 PLN
- 20-hour package: 3400 PLN

Mix and mastering:
- Stereo mix: from 500 PLN/track
- Stereo mastering: from 200 PLN/track
- Mix + mastering: from 600 PLN/track
- Stem mastering: from 350 PLN/track

## Recording Spaces

- **Studio 1** (40m²): Main space with Neumann U47 FET from Olympic Studios London
- **Studio 2** (28m²): Vocal studio with Stam Audio SA-800G tube microphone
- **Studio 3** (30m²): Production studio with vintage synths (Rhodes, Korg, Roland)
- **Mastering Room**: Professional mastering space

## Technical Specifications

Microphones: Neumann U47 FET, SM69 FET, TLM 170, Brauner Phanthera, Stam Audio SA-800G, AEA R84
Interfaces: Antelope Discrete 8 Pro / Discrete 4 with real-time FPGA processing
Preamps: UTA MPEQ-1 (Neve-style), Avedis MA-5, custom 1176 compressors
Features: Real-time Auto-Tune (<1ms latency), 24/7 operation, Nextcloud file delivery
